hypotheses.paper: the Rellich–Kondrachov theorem (l.720): (u_k) bounded in W^{1,2}(Σ) has a subsequence converging in L²(Σ)
hypotheses.note: now PROVED on the manifold layer: Mfd.rellich_kondrachov', exactly the round-1 statement of Mfd.rellich_kondrachov (Expr-checked). Proof: μ is finite (isFiniteMeasure_of_isLocallyLebesgue); good chart neighbourhoods (exists_goodChart), a finite subcover and a smooth partition of unity ρ_i subordinate to it (as in Mfd.assemble); on each chart local_cell_approx: v_i = chartFun (ρ_i u) is C¹ on ℍ̄ and vanishes outside the fixed compact φ_i(tsupport ρ_i) ⊆ closedBall 0 R_i; Half.cell_approx R_i δ gives ‖v_i − P_δ v_i‖_{L²(ℍ̄)} ≤ √(2·2^N·N) δ ‖Dv_i‖_{L²(ℍ̄)}; ρ_i u − Σ_z avg_{C_z}(v_i)·1_{V_i ∩ φ_i⁻¹C_z} = 1_{V_i}·(v_i − P_δ v_i)∘φ_i, so its L²(μ) norm is ≤ Cμ^{1/2}‖v_i − P_δ v_i‖_{L²(ℍ̄)} (eLpNorm_chart_comparable); ‖Dv_i‖_{L²(ℍ̄)} ≤ Cμ^{1/2}·c·‖u‖_{W^{1,2}} (the steps of local_sobolev, eLpNorm_dChart_mul_le). Summing over i: ‖u − Σ c·g‖_{L²(μ)} ≤ (Σ_i A_i) δ K ≤ ε for δ = ε/((Σ A_i)K + 1). The strict criterion exists_subseq_tendsto_eLpNorm_two (Yamabe.RellichCriterion) concludes; its arbitrary-coefficient form needs no bound on the cell averages, so REPORT-2's step (3) (bounded coefficients) is not needed.

hypotheses.paper: Σ compact Riemannian N-manifold with boundary; vol_g; (u_k) ⊂ W^{1,2}(Σ)
hypotheses.note: unchanged from round 1 (OQ-93 (a): every IsLocallyLebesgue μ, (b): W^{1,2} read as C¹ with ‖∇u‖_{L²} + ‖u‖_{L²} ≤ K). N ≥ 3 is not needed for this step. Finiteness of μ is derived, not assumed.

questions: No new reading. The paper cites Rellich–Kondrachov at l.720 without a reference or a precise form. The reading taken is the round-1 statement, under OQ-93 (a) and (b): every sequence of C¹ functions bounded in W^{1,2}(μ), for every locally-Lebesgue μ, has a subsequence converging in L²(μ) (eLpNorm → 0) to a limit f with MemLp f 2 μ. The weak W^{1,2} convergence of the same sentence stays carried by ConstLimit (OQ-93 (c)).

kb_proposals: Pattern: Rellich–Kondrachov on the manifold layer is Mfd.rellich_kondrachov' (YamabeScaffold.RellichManifold): Mfd.local_cell_approx gives, per good chart and C¹ cut-off ρ, an A < ∞ with ‖ρu − Σ_{z∈Z} avg_{C_z}(chartFun (ρu)) • 1_{V ∩ φ⁻¹ C_z}‖_{L²(μ)} ≤ A·δ·w12 g μ u for every δ > 0 (Z from Half.cell_approx); the global sum runs over β = Σ _ : t, (Fin N → ℤ) with s = Finset.univ.sigma Z, split by Finset.sum_sigma, Finset.sum_sub_distrib and u = Σ ρ_i u; exists_subseq_tendsto_eLpNorm_two concludes.

Pattern: a locally-Lebesgue μ is IsLocallyFiniteMeasure (Mfd.isLocallyFiniteMeasure_of_isLocallyLebesgue: interior U ∩ (chart source ∩ φ⁻¹ ball(φ x₀, 1)) has μ ≤ C·vol(ball)), so on a compact M `infer_instance` gives IsFiniteMeasure μ (CompactSpace.isFiniteMeasure through isFiniteMeasureOnCompacts_of_isLocallyFiniteMeasure): Mfd.isFiniteMeasure_of_isLocallyLebesgue. The [IsFiniteMeasure μ] binders of Mfd.Reads.rellichProp, Reads.constLimit, Reads.lem_positivity, Reads.cor_negative and Mfd.lem_positivity are derivable from hμ.

Pattern: check a primed copy syntactically inside the file with a run_cmd: find? both constants, compare levelParams.length, then `a.type == b.type.instantiateLevelParams b.levelParams (a.levelParams.map Level.param)` and throwError otherwise (Expr.eqv ignores binder names and info). Unlike `type_of% … = type_of% … := rfl` it rejects a copy that differs by unfolding a definition (tested: w12 unfolded).
Pitfall: Half.cell_approx R hδ leaves N a metavariable ('typeclass instance problem is stuck: NeZero ?m'): write Half.cell_approx (N := N) R hδ.
Pitfall: after `set φ := extChartAt (𝓡∂ N) x₀`, `simp only [chartFun_chart (hVs hy)]` does not fire on `chartFun N x₀ f (↑φ y)` (unused simp arg), while `rw [chartFun_chart (hVs hy)]` does.

Pattern: from the squared lintegral bound of Half.cell_approx to an eLpNorm bound: write the constant as ENNReal.ofReal (B * δ) ^ (2:ℝ), B = √(2·2^N·N), then `rw [← ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow_iff two_pos, ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ two_pos.le, ← lintegral_enorm_rpow_two_eq, ← lintegral_enorm_rpow_two_eq, hcδ]; exact hZv`.
